intended_object: Compatibility of two multigraphs on the same vertex and edge label types: every edge that lies in both edge sets has the same ends (the same incidence/link relation) in both graphs. Inferred from the docstring and the module's section comment.
explanation: The body says: for every edge `e` in both `E(G)` and `E(H)`, and all vertices `x y`, `G.IsLink e x y ↔ H.IsLink e x y`. In `Graph α β`, an edge is determined by its `IsLink` relation, so this says exactly that the shared edges have the same ends in both graphs, which is what the docstring states. Edges that lie in only one graph impose no condition, as they should; for example, graphs with disjoint edge sets are compatible (`Compatible.of_disjoint_edgeSet`). The relation is reflexive and symmetric, as expected. It is defined for any `Graph α β`, with no assumptions on `α` or `β`, so the generality is natural. This is the library's own definition; Mathlib has no other declaration of the same notion.
